title: Patch: three per-pull-request tests play their AI games at the test budget, not the quality gate's
thread:
**Issue #3289 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3289: Patch: three per-pull-request tests play their AI games at the test budget, not the quality gate's
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some tests that run on every pull request play whole games between two full-strength AIs, only to collect game positions or to check that a file comes out the same on one thread and on four. They test nothing about how well the AI plays, yet every game costs as much thinking as a quality-gate game, and CI jobs keep running past their time budget.

Once this is built, those tests play at the small budget other such tests already use. Their checks stay the same and they finish much sooner.

## Why

- `r1006001_the_same_base_and_count_give_byte_identical_lines_on_one_or_four_threads` (`crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs:427-442`) plays 3 games twice through `play`, which plays at `AI_GATE_BUDGET`. `play_at` (`selfplay.rs:266`) already takes a budget.
- `played(n)` (`crates/tools/src/positions.rs:410-412`) plays a gate-budget game. It is called five times (lines 448, 474, 501, 529 and 585), `played(1)` twice.
- `ready_gap_counts_exactly_the_units_legal_actions_lists_an_attack_for_from_either_seat` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs:189-200`) plays two AI-vs-greedy games at `AI_GATE_BUDGET` to collect states.
- `TEST_BUDGET` (`crates/tools/src/arena.rs:336-347`: 150 nodes, 40 lethal nodes, 1 determinization) is "the budget a test decides at when it plays whole games to prove how a game is dealt, seated, replayed or filed, not how well it is played". #3081 already moved three such tests to it.
- Measured on this checkout: `jackioh selfplay --games 3 --seed selfplay-test` at the gate budget took 25.1 s on one thread in a release build with thin LTO. The test profile builds the AI at opt-level 1 and the tools crate unoptimized, so these tests cost more than that.
- CI's `tools duos, selfplay` and `ai slow` groups (`scripts/ci-shards.toml`) run them on every engine, cards or AI change, and #3258 and #3162 were jobs that ran over seven minutes.

## Proposal

- `r1006001` calls `play_at(…, TEST_BUDGET)`.
- `played(n)` plays at `TEST_BUDGET`, each `n` once, cached in a `OnceLock` as `selfplay_records` does.
- `lethal.rs`'s two games play at a test budget. If the coverage floor its comment names then fails, the fix is more seeds, never a lower floor.
- Leave alone the tests whose names claim gate games: `match_.rs`'s b26 and r977000, and `decide.rs`'s r188.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs` and `crates/tools/src/positions.rs`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs`, plus a test-budget constant in the AI crate if the tools' one is out of reach there.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The three tests' assertions are unchanged and pass, and no test is deleted, ignored or loosened.
- [ ] The pull request reports each test's wall time before and after, on the same machine.
- [ ] `lethal.rs`'s coverage floor still holds without being lowered.

## Size and risks

Small, 3 files.

Risks:
- A lower budget falls back more often: R1489000 faults a game that falls back, but at 150 nodes the games filed clean (`arena.rs:340`).
- The positions tests need games long enough to cover their cases, so the builder checks each one's game still reaches what it asserts.

Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `refactor` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42176859562)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Three per-pull-request tests stop playing whole games at `AI_GATE_BUDGET` and play at the small test budget (150 nodes, 40 lethal nodes, 1 determinization):
- `r1006001_the_same_base_and_count_give_byte_identical_lines_on_one_or_four_threads`
- the five tests behind `played(n)` in `positions.rs`
- `ready_gap_counts_exactly_the_units_legal_actions_lists_an_attack_for_from_either_seat`

Every assertion stays as it is and no test is deleted, ignored or loosened. `played(n)` plays each `n` once and caches it. If the `with_attackers > 20` floor in `lethal.rs` fails, add seeds; never lower it. The PR reports each test's wall time before and after, on one machine.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs` | `change`. `r1006001` calls `play_at(…, TEST_BUDGET)`. Delete `play` (`#[cfg(test)]`, its only caller was `r1006001`) and reword `play_at`'s doc. |
| `crates/tools/src/positions.rs` | `change`. In `mod tests`: import `TEST_BUDGET` and `OnceLock`, drop the `AI_GATE_BUDGET` import, split `played` into `play` (the old body at `TEST_BUDGET`) and a caching `played`. Adjust the callers. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/support.rs` | `change`. Add `pub const TEST_BUDGET: SearchBudget` and import `AI_GATE_BUDGET`. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs` | `change`. The two `AiVsGreedy` games use `TEST_BUDGET`. Drop the `AI_GATE_BUDGET` import and update the comment. |

**Must not touch:**
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`
- `crates/ai/src/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`. A `crates/ai/src` change classifies as `Area::Ai` (`classify.rs:255`), which is why the AI's constant goes in the tests.
- `crates/tools/src/arena.rs`: `TEST_BUDGET` stays as it is.
- `match_.rs`, `decide.rs`, `scripts/ci-shards.toml`, `spec/`.

**Spec and rulings:** R1006001 (thread independence), R1489000 (a fallback faults a game), R1006003, R1006004, R1006006, R1171000 and R3112002 (the positions tests). No new rule is decided, so there is no new ruling and no patch fragment (#3081 touched three `.rs` files only). Do not rename any test: `spec check` ties each R-token in a name to its note.

## Steps

0. **Baseline timings, before any edit.** Compile first so compile time stays out of the numbers, then time each test alone, since each one plays its own games today.
   - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --no-run` and `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow --no-run`
   - `time cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1006001_the_same_base`
   - `time cargo test -p jackioh-tools positions::tests::<name>` for each of `r1006004`, `r1006003`, `r1006006`, `r1171000` and `r3112002`
   - `time cargo test -p jackioh-tools positions::tests` (the whole module)
   - `time cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow ready_gap_counts_exactly`
   - Add a temporary `eprintln!("with_attackers = {with_attackers}");` before `assert!(with_attackers > 20)` in `lethal.rs`, run the last command with `-- --nocapture`, and note the number. Remove the line when the work is done.
   - In `positions.rs`, add a temporary `eprintln!("n={n} result={} turns={} actions={} live={}", record.result.is_some(), record.turns, record.log.len(), live.len());` after `play_match`. Run the module with `-- --nocapture` and note the four games' numbers. Remove it later.

1. **`support.rs`.**
   - Add `AI_GATE_BUDGET` to the `use jackioh_ai::{…}` list, right after `AI_BUDGET`.
   - After `pub const HUMAN: PlayerId = PlayerId::P2;` add:
   ```rust
   /// The budget a test decides at when it plays whole games only to collect their states, not to
   /// judge how well the AI plays: `AI_GATE_BUDGET`'s search at about a quarter of its nodes and one
   /// determinization. The numbers of `crates/tools/src/arena.rs`'s `TEST_BUDGET`, which this crate
   /// cannot reach (the tools crate builds on it).
   pub const TEST_BUDGET: SearchBudget = SearchBudget {
       nodes: 150,
       lethal_nodes: 40,
       determinizations: 1,
       ..AI_GATE_BUDGET
   };
   ```
   The file's existing `#![allow(dead_code)]` covers the `ai` binary, which does not use it. Add no new `allow`.

2. **`lethal.rs`.**
   - Remove `AI_GATE_BUDGET` from the `use jackioh_ai::{…}` list (it is used nowhere else; an unused import fails clippy).
   - Add `TEST_BUDGET` to `use super::support::{AI, HUMAN, …}` after `HUMAN`.
   - In `ready_gap_counts_exactly_…`, change the `game_config(…)` argument `AI_GATE_BUDGET` to `TEST_BUDGET`. Keep `AI_GATE.seed_series`, `config.max_actions = Some(150)`, `for game_index in [1, 2]` and `assert!(with_attackers > 20)`.
   - Above the `for game_index` loop add: `// The two played matches only collect states, so they decide at TEST_BUDGET, not the gate's.`
   - Run `cargo fmt -p jackioh-ai` and check with `git diff` that only the edited lines moved.

3. **Check the floor** with the temporary print from step 0, using `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow ready_gap_counts_exactly -- --nocapture`.
   - If it passes, report the before and after counts.
   - If `with_attackers > 20` fails, add states and leave the floor at 20. Either append `states.extend(random_policy_states("lethal-ready-gap-5", 3, 600));` after the fourth series, or change the loop to `[1, 2, 3]`. Extend the comment above the series ("keep the coverage floor below honest") to name what you added.
   - Do not touch `with_attackers > 20`.

4. **`selfplay.rs`.**
   - In `mod tests`, after `use super::*;` add `use crate::arena::TEST_BUDGET;`.
   - In `r1006001_…` replace both `play("selfplay-test", 1, 3, "test")` with `play_at("selfplay-test", 1, 3, "test", TEST_BUDGET)`. Leave the rest of the test alone.
   - Delete `play` (the `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fn play(...)` and its doc). It would otherwise be dead code, which `-D warnings` rejects. `AI_GATE_BUDGET` stays imported: `play_chunks` still uses it.
   - Change `play_at`'s doc to: "Plays the games and returns their lines, in game order, both seats deciding at `budget` (the tests' way in; `run` streams). A test that proves how a game files, not how well it is played, passes `TEST_BUDGET`."

5. **`positions.rs` `mod tests`.**
   - Imports: remove `AI_GATE_BUDGET` from the `use jackioh_ai::{…}` line. After `use jackioh_engine::find_instance;` add a blank line, then `use std::sync::OnceLock;` and `use crate::arena::TEST_BUDGET;`. Run `cargo fmt -p jackioh-tools` to settle their order.
   - Rename the existing `fn played(n: i32) -> (SelfplayGame, Vec<(GameState, usize)>)` to `fn play(n: i32) -> Played`. Change `Some(AI_GATE_BUDGET)` to `Some(TEST_BUDGET)`. Keep the rest of the body.
   - Above it add `type Played = (SelfplayGame, Vec<(GameState, usize)>);`.
   - Add the cache, with a doc saying each game is played once for every test that asks for it, at `TEST_BUDGET`:
   ```rust
   fn played(n: i32) -> &'static Played {
       static GAMES: [OnceLock<Played>; 4] = [const { OnceLock::new() }; 4];
       GAMES[usize::try_from(n - 1).expect("game numbers start at 1")].get_or_init(|| play(n))
   }
   ```
   The games are numbers 1 to 4 (the callers use 1, 2, 3, 4, 1).
   - Callers: `let (game, live) = played(1);` now binds references.
     - Drop the `&` on `game` in every `fold_game(&game, …)` call: `fold_game(game, …)`. Clippy's `needless_borrow` otherwise fails the build. `&wrong`, `&unfinished` and `&old` stay.
     - In `r1006003`, change `let mut old = game;` to `let mut old = game.clone();`.
     - `live.iter()`, `game.log` and `game.result.is_some()` need no change.
   - In `r1171000`, reword the comment "Game 4 reaches In Too Deep's graveyard reward…" to say "At the gate budget game 4 reached…". R1965000 is proven in `lethal.rs`, not here, so this is the comment's only change.

6. **Verify each positions game still reaches what its test asserts.** Use the temporary print from step 0, comparing before and after:
   - Game 1 (`r1006004`, `r3112002`): finishes with a result. More than 10 Decision rows. Fewer Turn rows than Decision rows. Rows name card ids.
   - Game 2 (`r1006003`): must finish with a result, or `NoResult` could come before `NotReplayed`.
   - Game 3 (`r1006006`): finishes; Reply rows are non-empty and no more than the turn ends.
   - Game 4 (`r1171000`): more than 10 Decision rows.
   - If a game fails its test at `TEST_BUDGET`, do not edit the assertion. Make `GAMES` longer and give that test a higher game number. Say so in the report.

7. **Remove both temporary prints. Take the "after" timings** with the same commands as step 0.

## Tests

No test is added or renamed; the three listed above are the proof. Run:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1006001_the_same_base`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools positions::tests`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow lethal`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai --no-run`: `support.rs` is compiled into this binary too.

The tools tests are a bin target (`jackioh`), so the commands above find them without `--lib`.

## Done when

- [ ] `r1006001` plays `play_at(…, TEST_BUDGET)`; `play` is gone.
- [ ] `played(n)` plays at `TEST_BUDGET`, once per `n`, cached in a `OnceLock`.
- [ ] `lethal.rs` plays its two games at `TEST_BUDGET`; the floor is still `> 20`, with any added seeds named in the comment.
- [ ] No test is deleted, ignored or loosened; every assertion is unchanged; no new `allow`.
- [ ] The final message has a table of each test's wall time before and after, with the machine and commands, plus `with_attackers` before and after and the four games' turns and actions before and after.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.
- [ ] The harness's checks pass (clippy over the workspace, cargo tests, the rest).

## Risks

- **Unfinished or faulted games at 150 nodes.** R1489000 faults a game that falls back, but #3081 filed clean at 150 (`arena.rs:340`). Step 6 checks each game's result. `r1006001` compares the faults across thread counts anyway.
- **The floor.** Weaker AI play changes the collected states. Step 3 measures the count, and the fix is more seeds.
- **Memory.** The cache keeps four games' `Vec<GameState>` for the process. Watch the peak when the module runs; it should stay under a few hundred MB.
- **Dead code or unused imports.** Both fail `-D warnings`. Steps 2, 4 and 5 remove `AI_GATE_BUDGET` from two imports and delete `play`.
- **Determinism.** Seeds and series names are unchanged; only the budget moves, so no replay or golden file reads these games.

## Open questions

None. Decisions the task did not settle:
- The constant sits in `crates/ai/tests/ai/support.rs`. Rejected: a public `AI_TEST_BUDGET` in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` aliased by the tools' constant, because it changes the AI crate's source, which classifies as `Area::Ai` and ships in the WASM module.
- The AI test budget repeats `arena.rs`'s numbers (150/40/1) so both budgets stay one test budget. Rejected: a larger budget for `lethal.rs`, which is only worth trying if more seeds cannot hold the floor.
- `play` is deleted rather than kept: it has no caller left, and keeping it would break clippy.
````
